solution_path.title: Proposed Multi-Component Solution Path
steps: 1. Provision via QEMU/OVMF on Windows attached directly to the physical external SSD (or Ventoy vtoyboot VHD).
2. Install GRUB to the external SSD EFI System Partition with the `--removable` flag (`\EFI\BOOT\BOOTX64.EFI`) so NVRAM is not tied to the host motherboard.
gaps: Unverified cross-machine suspend/hibernate and proprietary GPU driver switching across arbitrary third-party motherboards.
